name: Tuscan Onion Soup (Carabaccia) with Sourdough Toast, Fried Egg & Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-low heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are very soft but not brown, 12-15 minutes. (Reduce heat, if necessary, to keep the onions from browning.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place almond flour, vinegar, and cinnamon in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp almond meal/flour
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
⅛ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are done, add almond mixture to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 minute more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Add broth to the pan with the onion, stir to combine the soup, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until flavors are blended, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan, place in the reserved bowl, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread slices and pan-fry until toasted on one side, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 slices sourdough bread

instructions.primary_message: Remove bread to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return bread to the skillet, toasted-side up, and continue to pan-fry until toasted on the other side, 1 minute more. Return to the plate. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium-high heat and add more oil. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 eggs
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp pure maple syrup
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is done, add Parmesan, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls, then top with toasted bread and eggs. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
